Key Health Wearables & Remote Monitoring
Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGMs):
Small wearable sensors placed on the arm or abdomen that track interstitial glucose 24/7, transmitting real-time trends to apps or clinical portals.
Cleveland Clinic
Wearable ECG Smartwatches:
Wrist devices equipped with electrical sensors to capture heart rhythms and detect abnormalities like atrial fibrillation.

Sleep Trackers:
Advanced rings or bands monitoring autonomic nervous system recovery, HRV, and sleep stages to flag nocturnal disturbances or sleep apnea risks.

Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM):
Cloud-connected ecosystems that stream vital signs from patient devices to centralized medical AI platforms for proactive clinical intervention.
